messages:
sara_ml: Heads-up: ran a concise quant-profile sweep for marlin-70b across regions (us-west H100, eu-central A100, apac-tokyo L40). Goal: find hybrid profiles (FP8/INT8) that materially cut latency/cost while keeping quality delta <1%.

sara_ml: Quick summary first: H100+INT8 gives the largest raw speedup but larger QA drift; A100+FP8 looks like the best balance (sub-1% delta with ~1.9x speed); L40+INT8 yields good latency but more variance on quality.

sara_ml: Representative steady-state numbers (2k context, batch=1, KV-cache warm):
```
GPU (region) | profile | p50 | p95 | p99 | tok/s | speedup vs FP16 | delta_acc (summ)
H100 (us-west) | FP16   | 20ms | 46ms | 110ms | 450  | 1.0 | +0.0%
H100 (us-west) | INT8   | 10ms | 30ms | 88ms  | 1150 | 2.6 | -2.1%
A100 (eu-c)    | FP16   | 36ms | 76ms | 160ms | 260  | 1.0 | +0.0%
A100 (eu-c)    | FP8    | 19ms | 44ms | 98ms  | 500  | 1.9 | -0.5%
L40  (apac)    | FP16   | 30ms | 66ms | 140ms | 360  | 1.0 | +0.0%
L40  (apac)    | INT8   | 14ms | 38ms | 120ms | 820  | 2.3 | -2.7%
```
Notes: tok/s measured under our continuous-batch harness; warm-KV. Numbers are medians from 3 runs each.

lee_perf: Which evals are you using for delta_acc? and any automated safety hits?

anita_eval: Eval buckets used:
- long-summarization (1k samples) — ROUGE/QA pass rate + numeric consistency check
- factual QA (800 samples) — exact answer match / hallucination flags
- instruction-following (2k samples) — edit-distance / token-level checks
Safety: FP8 run did not trigger policy-level filter hits; INT8 shows a few numeric hallucination regressions on table-to-text cases in summarization.

tony_infra: What kernels/paths did you pick per-GPU? Any compiler/navfus flags changed for region infra?

sara_ml: Kernel summary: H100 -> fused-attn-v4 + tensorcore-autotuned GEMM path; A100 -> tiled-matmul + fp8-kernel-v2 (custom scaling); L40 -> matmul-tiling + int8-streaming-kernel. Compiler flags: enabled nvfuser optimizations on A100, `--tune-gemm=aggressive` on H100 for INT8, microbatch=2 on L40 to limit memory spikes.

bench-bot: logs: s3://redwood-bench/1995123456/marlin70b_quant_profile/ contains perf traces, kernel selections, and eval diffs.

lee_perf: p99 for A100 FP8 vs H100 INT8? tails matter for SLAs.

sara_ml: p99s above: A100 FP8 = 98ms, H100 INT8 = 88ms. Note: INT8 p99s are often dominated by kernel-sync stalls during long multi-chunk prompts; we observed reduced tail after adding async-kv flush in a dev-nightly.

anita_eval: Rollout recommendation:
- Stage FP8 on A100 (eu) as primary candidate: A/B with strict QA monitors (ROUGE drop <0.8%, numeric check pass rate within 0.7%).
- Treat H100+INT8 as opt-in canary: gate by summarization QA delta <1.5% and manual review of numeric-table cases.
- Defer L40+INT8 wide rollout until 24h stability + more eval coverage (we saw variance).

tony_infra: I'll create a canary route and automatic fallback to FP16 on QA alert. Who owns runbook and gating automation?

sara_ml: I'll own the rollout runbook and will coordinate the canary metrics. Anita owns QA gating thresholds. Tony sets up routing/fallback.

bench-bot: deploy-bot: canary route created -> /models/marlin-70b?profile=fp8&region=eu-central; canary id=cb-1995123456
